description: Three LLM market makers (two Muse Spark, one Muse Spark Open) compete alongside the GLFT benchmark. Each variant changes one exchange rule.

variants.name: tick_x5
variants.label: Tick size x5
variants.change: Minimum price increment raised from 1 to 5 cents.

variants.name: maker_rebate
variants.label: Maker rebate
variants.change: Makers are paid 2 bps per fill; takers pay 3 bps.

variants.name: speed_bump
variants.label: Speed bump
variants.change: Quotes must rest at least 20 steps before they can be cancelled.

variants.name: more_makers
variants.label: Twice the makers
variants.change: Three more LLM market makers enter.

variants.name: circuit_breaker
variants.label: Circuit breaker
variants.change: Trading halts for 50 steps after a 0.5% move within 100 steps.
